statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is weekend-closed; Tail is 19% while Gulf energy-route disruption keeps Stress at 100%.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH because persistent NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the weekend closure.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low as Gulf disruption holds Stress at 100%
body: NQ futures remain closed. A Sunday decline in Saudi equities confirms regional market stress after attacks on energy infrastructure, while no live NQ path is available to establish persistent mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: From 09:00 UTC September 12 through 08:00 UTC September 13, published hourly state remained EA_ON with Tail at 19%; Stress rose from 97% to 100% as Gulf disruption intensified during the weekend closure.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low through most of the closure, enters WATCH at 19:00 UTC, peaks at 24% around the 22:00 UTC reopen, and returns to low only if post-open trading develops meaningful retracements and two-way structure.

forecast.analysis: Weekend-closed NQ provides no live path evidence. Saudi shares are down after the pipeline attack, confirming regional stress but not NQ mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Weekend closure; no live NQ path

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is closed; Saudi equities confirm regional stress, but no live NQ mean-reversion failure is observable.
Closed-market gap uncertainty remains a Stress input; future direction is not treated as observed.
No live NQ price discovery is available, so the eventual reopening path remains conditional.
Energy-route disruption is material, while Tail still depends on later retracement quality and persistence.
Friday strength is prior-session context only and does not determine the Sunday reopening structure.
Absent fresh escalation, closed-market uncertainty remains high without evidence for Tail above 19%.
